official_product_and_legal_original_chan.evidence: NordVPN official Android product page offers an APK version and cautions against third-party or modded APKs; its link resolves to the nordcdn sideload channel retained in G299, whose HTTP x-digest equals the original APK SHA. Direct official distribution supports lawful acquisition of the original package.
official_product_and_legal_original_chan.boundary: The vendor download URL is moving; the x-signature and publisher key have not been independently verified.

exact_package_and_version.evidence: Current original-file SHA equals G299 raw admission; independent G299 aapt2/apksigner/ZIP/ELF checks identify this exact package, version and ARM64 artifact.
exact_package_and_version.boundary: Google Play identity is package-level, not proof that Play serves these same sideload bytes.

overseas_mainstream.evidence: The US-English Google Play listing for exact id=com.nordvpn.android names Nord Security and shows 100M+ worldwide downloads and about 1.36M reviews; the US storefront is an overseas market signal.
overseas_mainstream.boundary: The worldwide lifetime bucket is neither US installs nor downloads of version 9.14.1+sideload.

complete_client_blackbox_source_boundary.evidence: The tested input is the unmodified executable Android APK, with no complete Android client source used by the project. NordVPN's trust page identifies open Linux CLI/GUI source, which does not constitute source for this Android client. This supports treating the original Android client as a black-box test input.
complete_client_blackbox_source_boundary.boundary: This does not prove that complete source for the exact Android build exists nowhere; open components or Linux source do not turn the APK into a white-box test.

unmodified_project_input.evidence: G299 root admission accepts this original APK as unmodified; present SHA still matches and G300 made no APK/source edit.
unmodified_project_input.boundary: A later runtime copy needs its own SHA readback.

publisher_signer_binding: UNPROVEN: no independently publisher-published certificate fingerprint or independently verified Nord publisher signature on the exact APK digest. Embedded O=Tefincom DN, Google Play developer name, and HTTPS distribution are not interchangeable signer attestation.
minimal_supplement: Obtain Nord's official Android signing-certificate SHA-256 or publisher-signed exact-release checksum/key; compare or verify against the retained original bytes. A pinned Nord public key verifying the recorded x-signature/x-digest would bind bytes to publisher, not by itself Play byte identity.
limits: No OH7/Bionic install, truly-cold start, screen, input or VPN-service test
No device, container, graph or Bridge command in G300
Root qualification decision and canonical count are separate
